
**Data Collection Methods**: 
- `Google News Feed`: Accessed news feed through the SerpApi Google News API, which tracks real-time and historical collection of news data. 

- `MBTA Open Data Portal`: Datasets, such as service alerts, prediction accuracy, and reliability metrics, were downloaded in tabular formats (.csv and .json) from the MBTA Bluebook Open Data Portal.

- `Financial Data`: Key financial performance indicators were collected from MBTA's audited financial reports. They were originally in .pdf formats. Therefore, we used the [camelot](https://camelot-py.readthedocs.io/en/master/) library to extract data automatically from pdfs and exported them into csv format.
